listings.price_note: Fully furnished · 3 BR option also available
listings.summary: A modern tropical two-bedroom villa with a warm terracotta design, a curved designer pool with its own waterslide and waterfall, and a jacuzzi master suite, minutes from Pandawa and Melasti beaches.
listings.description:
This boutique villa concept is built to stand out in a short-term rental market full of look-alike boxes. Terracotta-toned walls, arched openings, green tiles and granite finishes give every room a warm, photogenic character.

On the ground floor, a sunken living area opens onto the pool deck, alongside a fully fitted kitchen and dining bar, a guest bedroom looking straight onto the pool and waterslide, and an ensuite with a walk-in shower. Upstairs, the master bedroom has a private balcony and an ensuite with a freestanding side-view jacuzzi bathtub.

The villa sits between Pandawa, Melasti and Nusa Dua, one of South Bali's fastest-growing areas: Pandawa Beach about 5 minutes away, Melasti Beach 7 minutes, cafés, supermarkets and padel courts within 5 minutes, and Savaya, White Rock and Sundays beach clubs within 8 to 12 minutes. The airport is roughly 35 minutes.

The project is under construction (around 40% complete at last update) and is sold fully furnished. Payment is staged: 5% booking deposit, 15% at contract signing, 75% over 10 monthly instalments and 5% at handover. A three-bedroom version is also available from USD 249,000.

listings.summary: The most accessible way into a limited wellness-focused collection: a compact three-bedroom freehold villa with a private pool, inside a wellness-focused enclave in Nyanyi.
listings.description:
This villa is the entry point to the collection. Its 149 m² layout is efficient rather than small: an open kitchen and dining room of around 27 m² flows onto a private plunge pool, with three bedrooms and three bathrooms arranged over two levels, plus off-street parking.

It suits buyers who want freehold ownership and the full lifestyle of the estate (wellness centre, managed rental and district amenities) at the lowest price point in the collection, or investors looking for a manageable three-bedroom rental unit.

The villa is part of a limited collection of 24 freehold residences in Nyanyi, each designed by an internationally acclaimed, wellness-focused architect with its own floor plan, orientation and landscape. Natural materials, biophilic forms and passive cooling shape every home. At the heart of the estate is a wellness centre with spa, gym, sauna, hydrotherapy, an indoor pool, hot and cold plunge pools and a communal bathhouse, alongside a café, a private ring road, EV charging and solar power.

The land is freehold in a tourism (pink) zone, so the villa can be lived in, used as a holiday home or rented short or long term through the estate's professional management. It sits inside a master-planned creative and lifestyle district, with an international school nearby and Nyanyi Beach a short drive away. Construction is under way, with handover scheduled for Q3 2027. The payment plan is 30/30/40. All payments are made in Indonesian Rupiah; USD figures are for reference.

listings.summary: A limited collection of 14 art-led freehold villas among the rice fields of Umalas, between Canggu and Seminyak, with a private pool in every one- to three-bedroom home.
listings.description:
A limited collection of 14 private residences among the peaceful rice fields of Umalas, one of Bali's most established residential areas between Canggu and Seminyak. Designed by a respected architect, the villas combine contemporary tropical architecture, Mediterranean influences and an art-led approach to living.

Three configurations are available, each with a private pool, contemporary kitchen and private outdoor area:

- 2-bedroom: from USD 389,000, 3 bathrooms, approx. 210 m² land, 220 m² building

listings.title: Completed 2 BR Joglo Villas in a Boutique Resort in Sidemen
listings.summary: Two-bedroom traditional Joglo residences within an operating boutique resort in the green hills of Sidemen, East Bali, surrounded by rice terraces.
listings.description:
In the green hills of East Bali, these two-bedroom residences pair the character of traditional Joglo architecture with contemporary comfort, inside an intimate boutique resort that is already operating. Exposed teak structures, high ceilings, handcrafted details, natural stone floors, bespoke wooden furniture and canopy beds give the interiors warmth and texture, and open-plan living areas flow onto garden-facing terraces.

Sidemen is known for its terraced rice fields, river valleys and traditional village life, a slower, nature-focused side of Bali. Gembleng Waterfall and the Telaga Waja River are nearby, with the Tirta Gangga and Taman Ujung water palaces within day-trip distance.

Residences range from about 99 to 142 m² of building on 187 to 273 m² of land, each with ensuite bathrooms featuring bathtubs and open showers, under professional resort management.
highlights: Traditional Joglo architecture with exposed teak
Ensuite bathrooms with bathtubs and open showers
listings.yield_note: Developer projection: annual rental yield of about 12.6%, based on a ten-year average model. This is the developer's estimate, not a guaranteed return.
